reuse.why: Folds the skipWeekend flag and holidays into the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper, but the daily-skip decision is not put in a shared helper and getDatesInRange re-tests d.isWeekend||isHoliday instead of reusing the (unexported) isNonWorkingDay.

duplication.why: The daily-skip filter is written twice inside getNextDate and again in getDatesInRange, and schedule-template.ts keeps its outer skipWeekend ternary while also passing the flag into the helper, so the weekend decision is still repeated.

placement.why: Holiday/weekend moving sits in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-skip decision is written inline in getNextDate and in the server handler instead of one shared definition as Step 0 asks.

scope.why: All edits serve the requested steps; no unrelated changes beyond an import addition.

maintainability.why: Step 0's 'one definition' goal is only partly met: the skip/move decision is spread over getNextDate, getDatesInRange, getUpcomingDates (which ignores daily skipping) and the budget template (outer ternary, no daily skip), with magic look-ahead constants.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts call getDateWithSkippedWeekend directly for daily schedules, bypassing the daily-skip rule; getDatesInRange re-implements the daily-skip check inline

disguised_duplication.where: daily skip appears as isDailyWithSkippedWeekends filters (x2) in getNextDate and as a null-returning map branch in getDatesInRange; schedule-template keeps `skipWeekend ? helper(..., skipWeekend===true) : date`

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains skipWeekend and holidays; getNextDate gains two isDailyWithSkippedWeekends filter branches; getDatesInRange reimplements the rule while getUpcomingDates and schedule-template.ts bypass it
